notesForDeepResearch: Verify housing, appointed PCO/DMC and participant-arranged lodging for every accepted candidate.
Prioritize CMEE, LabFaB and SABR for accessibility checks because no competing host hotel was identified in reviewed evidence.
For venue-confirmed candidates investigate only overflow, speakers/VIPs, side meetings, receptions or future-edition capture.
Confirm attendance and room-block values before customer presentation.
materialUncertainties: No candidate has a published room block or peak-room figure in the evidence reviewed.
Hotel silence is treated as unconfirmed, never as open.
Confirmed host hotels and venues are not treated as available inventory.
Restaurant/lounge status and actual F&B capability require separate verification.

result.text: Structured discovery of 11 future Toronto event opportunities, with exact dates and venues, honest sourcing-status treatment, hotel-fit constraints, dispositions, and research uncertainties. Confirmed competing venues are not treated as open inventory.
